people.name: Martha
people.line: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

translations.web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
translations.bsb: As they traveled along, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
translations.asv: Now as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
